# Desktop development toolchain. The class owns the active Mise and Cloudflare
# APT sources. The class-gated late helper installs verified upstream Deno,
# yt-dlp with bundled yt-dlp-ejs, the Ansible CLI from Ansible Core, OpenTofu,
# Terraform, Packer,
# Wrangler, Aptly, osc, and obs-build releases into isolated /usr/local/lib
# roots instead of installing their Debian packages. Debian ffmpeg/ffprobe
# provide the media merge and post-processing backend for yt-dlp.
# OpenTofu, HashiCorp, and Aptly repository examples stay commented for
# operator reference only. Debian Experimental is enabled by fragments/apt.cfg
# for the explicit LLVM 24 toolchain; LLVM 21 and 22 remain installed from
# Forky. Keep the compiler/linker families for LLVM 21, 22, and 24, but select

base-apt.debconf:
##########  Mirror / APT defaults  ##########
d-i debian-installer/allow_unauthenticated boolean false
d-i debian-installer/allow_unauthenticated_ssl boolean false
d-i mirror/country string manual
d-i mirror/protocol select https
d-i mirror/codename string forky
d-i mirror/suite string forky
d-i mirror/udeb/suite string forky
#d-i mirror/http/hostname string deb.debian.org
#d-i mirror/http/directory string /debian/
#d-i mirror/http/proxy string
d-i mirror/https/countries select manual
#d-i mirror/https/hostname string deb.debian.org
#d-i mirror/https/mirror select deb.debian.org
#d-i mirror/https/directory string /debian/
d-i mirror/https/hostname string mirrors.glesys.net                                                                                                                                       
d-i mirror/https/mirror select mirrors.glesys.net                                                                                                                                      
d-i mirror/https/directory string /debian/
d-i mirror/https/proxy string
d-i apt-setup/use_mirror boolean true
d-i apt-setup/cdrom/set-first boolean false
d-i apt-setup/disable-cdrom-entries boolean true
d-i apt-setup/no_mirror boolean false
d-i apt-setup/services-select multiselect security, updates, backports
d-i apt-setup/security_host string security.debian.org
d-i apt-setup/security_path string /debian-security
d-i apt-setup/non-free boolean true
d-i apt-setup/contrib boolean true
d-i apt-setup/non-free-firmware boolean true
d-i apt-setup/backports boolean true

##########  Inofficial APT Archives  ##########
# Debian Sid (Unstable)
d-i apt-setup/local0/repository string https://mirrors.glesys.net/debian sid main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
d-i apt-setup/local0/comment string Debian Sid (Unstable)
d-i apt-setup/local0/key string https://ftp-master.debian.org/keys/archive-key-13.asc
d-i apt-setup/local0/source boolean true

# Debian Trixie (Stable)
d-i apt-setup/local1/repository string https://mirrors.glesys.net/debian trixie main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
d-i apt-setup/local1/comment string Debian Trixie (Stable)
d-i apt-setup/local1/key string https://ftp-master.debian.org/keys/archive-key-13.asc
d-i apt-setup/local1/source boolean true

# Debian XanMod Kernel
d-i apt-setup/local2/repository string https://deb.xanmod.org forky main non-free
d-i apt-setup/local2/comment string XanMod kernel archive
d-i apt-setup/local2/key string https://dl.xanmod.org/archive.key
d-i apt-setup/local2/source boolean false

# OBS home:cramerz:debian Debian_Unstable
d-i apt-setup/local3/repository string https://downloadcontent.opensuse.org/repositories/home:/cramerz:/debian/Debian_Unstable/ /
d-i apt-setup/local3/comment string OBS home:cramerz:debian Debian_Unstable
d-i apt-setup/local3/key string https://downloadcontent.opensuse.org/repositories/home:cramerz:debian/Debian_Unstable/Release.key
d-i apt-setup/local3/source boolean false

# Debian Experimental
# Satty 0.21.1's upstream binary needs GLIBC_2.43, and the DevOps addon
# explicitly installs the LLVM 24 toolchain from this signed archive. The
# default pin keeps unrequested Experimental packages out of normal upgrades.
d-i apt-setup/local20/repository string https://mirrors.glesys.net/debian experimental main
d-i apt-setup/local20/comment string Debian Experimental (explicit LLVM 24 and private Satty runtime)
d-i apt-setup/local20/key string https://ftp-master.debian.org/keys/archive-key-13.asc
d-i apt-setup/local20/source boolean false

# Debian Forky (Testing)
#d-i apt-setup/local4/repository string https://deb.debian.org/debian forky main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
#d-i apt-setup/local4/comment string Debian Forky (Testing)
#d-i apt-setup/local4/key string https://ftp-master.debian.org/keys/archive-key-13.asc
#d-i apt-setup/local4/source boolean true

# Mullvad Browser and VPN
d-i apt-setup/local7/repository string https://repository.mullvad.net/deb/stable stable main

d-i apt-setup/local7/key string https://repository.mullvad.net/deb/mullvad-keyring.asc

# resolver ownership transition cannot disrupt the shared pkgsel transaction.

# transitions.
d-i pkgsel/include string mullvad-browser
